title: refactor: extract shared email template rendering
body:
## Summary
The notification service and the report-delivery service both had their own Jinja2 template rendering logic — same patterns, slightly different implementations. This PR extracts a shared `TemplateRenderer` class into `src/shared/email/` that both services now use.

Also cleaned up some dead code in the notification service that was left over from the old Mailgun integration.

## Test plan
- Existing notification tests still pass
- Existing report-delivery tests still pass
- Added unit tests for the shared TemplateRenderer

commits.messageHeadline: chore: remove dead Mailgun email builder
